standards.description: The power of a machine is the rate of transferring energy; more power does the same work faster.
standards.traceDetail: Speed knob changes watts while work total stays fixed.

standards.description: The rate of work, or power, is how fast a system transfers energy — measured in joules per second (watts).
standards.traceDetail: Watt meter equals work counter divided by the lift time.

standards.description: Understand the concept of a ratio and unit rate and use rate language in the context of a ratio.
standards.traceDetail: Joules-per-second rate reasoning; comparisons of two rates.
